name: Elliott Smith
title: Director, Product Operations
quote: As her team operations partner, I had to fight off product managers and business stakeholders who constantly wanted to work with her on every one of their projects. She built the reputation of being Design Lead "John Wick," as her focus and determination in taking on any problem resulted in a well-thought, thorough strategic approach. Her direct reports frequently cited her passion for learning impacted their growth and was a top reason they loved working with her.
